source_policy.late_source_paths_rule: Four explicit reviewed path prefixes; new registration planning area belongs to next reviewed cutoff
source_policy.content_audit_scope: Git tree names, sizes and Blob SHAs plus inherited category and path families; not byte-by-byte semantic review of all source files
source_policy.git_tree_identity_note: Tree SHA obtained independently from GET git/commits/{source_main_sha}; the original git/trees/<commit-ref> response may echo the lookup ref and is not used as Tree identity

source_path_scan.deletion_policy: Do not delete production data, frozen provenance, source/fixtures, explicit drafts or structural placeholders without audited impact and passing tests

nonclaims: This is an internally authored taxonomy, not an OSF-approved registration
No automated proof that each file is semantically necessary
Historical-only paths are already absent from main, not deleted by this review
This is not an exact-byte validation of every external scientific record
